phases.name: pripyat-online-models
phases.lua:
assert(level.name() == 'pripyat')
local models = {}
local objects, with_visual = 0, 0
level.iterate_online_objects(function(object)
  objects = objects + 1
  local name = object:get_visual_name()
  if name and name ~= '' then
    models[name] = true
    with_visual = with_visual + 1
  end
  return false
end)
local names, monolith = {}, 0
for name in pairs(models) do
  names[#names + 1] = name
  if string.find(name, 'monolit', 1, true) then monolith = monolith + 1 end
end
table.sort(names)
assert(#names > 0 and with_visual >= #names)
for _, name in ipairs(names) do log1('SHADER_PRIPYAT_VISUAL ' .. name) end
log1(string.format('SHADER_SWEEP CENSUS map=%s objects=%d with_visual=%d models=%d monolith=%d', level.name(), objects, with_visual, #names, monolith))
